decisions.reason: The portable reference electrometer sits at the core of the firm's established dosimetry business and is featured on the home page, which suggests results that meet aspirations, and the expanding firm has the slack to keep it.

The oncology risk management software extends the firm's QA strategy, has its own web presence, and was launched only recently; with growth and organisational slack there is no shortfall to trigger a search for other uses of its resources.
